cases.request: Local mode / offline inspect
cases.expected: zero Cloud calls, no payment or price oracle required

cases.request: mainnet quote settled in real SOL
cases.expected: production environment only, correct genesis/treasury

cases.request: devnet test SOL payment
cases.expected: sandbox Cloud only; never production

cases.request: testnet test SOL payment
cases.expected: sandbox Cloud only; tolerate resets and RPC outage

cases.request: Cloud pay-per-check without an account
cases.expected: no registration, credit balance or device certificate

cases.request: trusted fresh SOL/USD quote
cases.expected: lamports computed by checked integer ceiling division

cases.request: carried-forward old price or stale timestamp
cases.expected: no price quote issued

cases.request: confidence too wide or independent feeds disagree
cases.expected: no price quote issued

cases.request: pricing oracle unavailable
cases.expected: no price quote, no unexpected charge

cases.request: USD micros=10000 and SOL/USD micros=100000000
cases.expected: exactly 100000 lamports

cases.request: huge USD price or near-zero SOL/USD
cases.expected: arithmetic rejected safely

cases.request: computed lamports above client cap
cases.expected: reject quote, never auto-pay

cases.request: payment broadcast after signed quote expiry
cases.expected: do not perform paid check; review/refund as appropriate

cases.request: SOL/USD changes after signed quote
cases.expected: quote amount frozen until expiry; no surprise repricing

cases.request: checked transaction hash/subject set changed after quote
cases.expected: reject mismatched paid check

cases.request: correct transfer but no unique memo in same transaction
cases.expected: not a valid settlement for this quote

cases.request: same lamports sent to wrong address or donation wallet
cases.expected: reject; donation is never a paid invoice

cases.request: devnet payment signature presented to mainnet Cloud
cases.expected: reject, no account/balance transfer

cases.request: only unconfirmed or rolled-back RPC observation
cases.expected: pending; not settled

cases.request: same finalized payment proof for two quotes
cases.expected: single claim/check only

cases.request: unknown claimant uses observed public tx signature
cases.expected: reject absent matching 256-bit private claim

cases.request: client disconnects after finalized payment
cases.expected: same claim can resume without second payment

cases.request: service unavailable after successful SOL transfer
cases.expected: retain one-check claim for retry or documented refund

cases.request: same public key on mainnet and testnet
cases.expected: no shared credentials, claims or finances

cases.request: no consent to send raw protected tx
cases.expected: metadata only, no server simulation

cases.request: CloudAssessment changed or signed under wrong key
cases.expected: reject Cloud evidence and fail according to profile

cases.request: server reports no known risk but local hard DENY
cases.expected: final CLI SecurityVerdict remains DENY

cases.request: CloudAssessment valid but PaymentReceipt invalid
cases.expected: separate verification; do not claim valid receipt

cases.request: classical-only TLS group or invalid server identity
cases.expected: reject Cloud connection, free local mode still available

cases.request: devnet/testnet reset or faucet unavailable
cases.expected: no production dependency; sandbox states may be reset
